## Commensurability

| Pair | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| paper method (gate QK/PQK) vs paper baseline (best classical) | COMMENSURABLE | same units, paired seeds, subsample, split, N, test points, metric and selection protocol |
| MerLin adaptation (photonic FQK/PQK) vs best classical in the photonic runs | COMMENSURABLE | same pipeline and pairing; the classical models are trained on the same photonic labels |
| capped-photon regime (k ≤ 8) vs k = floor(m/2) regime | PARTIALLY_COMMENSURABLE | identical setup for m ≤ 17; for m ≥ 18 the photon number, Fock space and therefore labels differ, so only paired differences to each regime's own best classical model are compared |
| MerLin adaptation vs paper method (gate) | PARTIALLY_COMMENSURABLE | same inputs, classical suite, protocol and seeds, but different labels (photonic vs gate QNN observable; engineered labels built from different kernels), so raw metrics are not directly comparable; compare paired differences to each family's own best classical model |
| local results vs paper-reported values | PARTIALLY_COMMENSURABLE | same protocol family but n ≤ 16 vs ≤ 30, inferred conventions (input scale), regenerated labels; paper values come from test-set selection (compare with protocol 'paper') |
| any local result vs paper-reported MerLin/photonic values | N/A | the paper has no photonic experiments |
